scope: Ordinary seekable Matroska/WebM VP9 Profile 0, 8-bit 4:2:0 SDR, fixed dimensions <=4096x2160, visible single-frame packets. Hardware required on every decoder creation, no software video decoder or commercial SDK. Existing audio restrictions apply; managed networking/bounded buffering and advanced VP9 remain excluded.

nativeBridge.pcmReference: Independent Xiph libvorbis1.3.7/libogg1.3.6 built by pinned test-only script; not shipped.

review.finding: Seek/recreation could accept a changed color/range keyframe while retaining the original vpcC. Immutable opening bitstream configuration now survives decoder history reset.
review.regression: Three header assertions failed before the fix; all 218 pass after, plus a public range-change seek rejection.

routingRegression.before: WebM production flag was disabled; public routes rejected container.unsupported and new route test failed six assertions.
routingRegression.after: WebM enters inspection; actual stream preparation and hardware evidence remain mandatory. Focused route test and existing seven-test assessment suite pass.

retainedGap: Original WebM VP9/Vorbis fixture has nonzero CodecDelay and still fails decoder.audio_vorbis_unsupported; no fixture or audio guard was relaxed.
